originality.rationale: The known Akiyama–Kamae full polygon width-moment formula is credited and not presented as new. The novel assessed statement is the exact nondegenerate four-parameter Morse signature of the square, including its positive central-symmetry tangent plane and two negative symmetry-breaking directions. The inspected source discusses a global kite candidate but neither the square Hessian nor the local Morse index. A universal forward moment formula enables the calculation but does not itself state or classify this critical-point signature; unpublished equivalent calculations remain possible.
residual_risks: Priority is best-knowledge rather than an independent exhaustive historical proof.

The 2024 journal text beyond the preprint and unindexed later works were not all independently examined.
